design: Use the first holdout request and its two scored source edits. For the generation experiment use routing-design.json and replace only the request-type source. Use one seed for both arms in all four setups, and reset it before each generation. Preserve incomplete comparisons. Each metric counts distinct input bodies once across seeds.
metrics: changed tool name or transition between text and tool
repeat_disagreement: Within one setup and metric, at least one seed yields a completed unchanged pair and another seed yields a completed changed pair. A failed arm supplies no outcome.
